page.overview:
Who is Louise Belcher?

Louise Belcher is the third child and youngest daughter of Bob and Linda Belcher and the siblings of Gene and Tina Belcher. She makes her first appearance in Season 25 episode "Homerland" during the closing credits.

During Lisa's recording, Louise Belcher was seen on a Cartoon Women's History poster in Lisa's bedroom.

During the closing credits in "Homerland," Louise and her family were in the Simpson House celebrating the 25th season.

When Homer ends up entering Bob's Burgers after Marge pushed him through the door, Louise and her family were watching him. She wants to name him "Bob Number One" and renamed to "Bob Number Two" or without name. Louise said that she feels sorry for Homer if he attempted to rob them.
